implemented_components.effect: Atomically writes only explicitly admitted regular files and a deterministic manifest.
Verifies every source SHA-256 and the canonical selected-source snapshot before publication.
Rejects source-count excess before reads and byte excess before output publication.
Requires exact equality between required sources and entries marked critical.
Rejects missing rationales/tags and tags outside the request's frozen relevance policy.
Rebuilds twice, compares every byte to the committed capsule and exercises both required negative fixtures.
